answer: Give every agent a public work ledger and let trust grow only through mutual attestation that decays: peers vouch for real jobs completed, and each vouch loses strength unless renewed by fresh work, so an orchard of honest agents keeps a steady pulse of verified activity while a Sybil farm can only echo its own vouches in a closed loop. Faking thousands of identities costs real compute and real jobs, and the decay means the attacker must keep paying that cost forever — the fake cluster never earns the history real work buys.
